newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian share volume climbs again.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian share volume climbs again.

text.p: Lithuanian share trade rose sharply again on Wednesday, with Rokiskis and Lithuanian Gas most active as bloc trades beating the central market.
Overall market volume on the central market doubled from Tuesday's session to reach 2.10 million litas.
Total block trades worth 11.51 million litas were made on Wednesday but there was no trade on the secondary T-bill market.
The Group A index, tracking the bourse's 35 most active listings, was pushed up 231.99 points to 2,537.4.
Rokiskis, an active stock lately, gained to 31.1 litas from 30 litas on volume of 254,335 litas on the central market.
Rokiskis, a cheese maker, registered the largest single deal in block trades, worth 9.46 million litas at 22.3 litas.
Lithuanian Gas, in busy trade as usual, rose to 2.06 litas from 1.92 litas and turned over 284,448 litas.
Birzai Milk was unchanged at 9.5 litas and turned over shares worth 105,719 litas.
On the bank market, Ukio Bank was the most active on the central market and saw its shares rise to 38.01 litas from 31.68 litas, registering activity of 201,605 litas.
Hermis Bank ended four litas higher at 239 litas turning over 107,072 litas on the central market. It saw business of 1.19 million litas in block trades in a range of 237 to 221.
